status: Source-only two-stage model-family gate; no target artifact may be opened.
claim_boundary: Inverse-dynamics competence is diagnostic only. Promotion requires cross-fitted official-Warp trajectory gains and discrepancy shrinkage. A later result on previously examined targets cannot establish an independent state-of-the-art claim.
hypothesis: A bounded gravity-aware E(3)-equivariant graph model can transfer state-, action-, and regime-dependent generalized-force discrepancy across interactions when its global weights are source-trained and only a low-dimensional latent is adapted on each held-out prefix.

information_boundary.complete_source_training: Complete registered outcomes may supervise shared weights only for non-held-out source interactions.
information_boundary.heldout_adaptation: Only the held-out case latent may use frames [0, fit_end); global weights and all hyperparameters remain frozen.
information_boundary.heldout_scoring: Official Warp is rerun from the permitted prefix state and scored only on [fit_end, train_end).
information_boundary.target_access: No target file, trajectory, observation, metric, checkpoint, query, or future artifact may be read by either source stage.
information_boundary.reliability: Prior reliability may use source confidence, validity, geometry, visibility, and graph support, but never the PhysTwin state residual.
information_boundary.innovation: The state innovation enters once through robust inverse-dynamics target construction.
information_boundary.prob4d: Prob4D remains a separate optional observation feeder and is not used in this source mechanism gate.
information_boundary.causal4d: No Causal4D held-v8 artifact, operator, target, query, score, or outcome is accessed.

required_controls: prefix state update without learned force
learned force with graph-persistence refitted on top
forbidden: opening any target artifact when either source stage fails
selecting architecture, target construction, force cap, seeds, folds, or thresholds from held-out suffix metrics
using held-out suffix frames to adapt the case latent or initialize the held-out rollout
using a PhysTwin residual as both a prior reliability cue and a robust innovation
calling force-target RMSE a simulator or state-of-the-art result
claiming a physical mechanism unless the held-out readout correction shrinks
modifying frozen Causal4D or Prob4D protocol artifacts
